text_block_list.text:
Our second summer camp is here. Smart
Falcon
changes into her swimsuit
straightaway, eager to
get started.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Recently, the nickname "Сайленс Судзука
of the
Sand" has been gaining popularity
among fans.
She vows to do the name
justice by getting even
stronger.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
